highlights: Design, build, and evolve backend systems for a multi-team platform on the critical path for 20+ teams (7 pilot squads) — own projects end-to-end: clarify requirements, drive technical design, implement solutions, manage rollout, and support production.

Founded the Agentic Developer Platform (ADP), a multi-team bootstrap and governance infrastructure for MCP servers, agents, and skills; built in 4 weeks on a multi-agent orchestration pattern and rolled out to 7 pilot squads with 20+ skills, 20+ agents, and 20+ teams.

Improved reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness: telemetry and governance with cost/adoption metrics — reduced case task resolution time by 90%, cut automation development from days to hours on legacy codebases, lifted legacy test coverage from 20% to 90%, and reduced external defects by 90%.

Contributed to Build Agent in ServiceNow Studio — metadata-aware, multi-model platform across 35+ metadata types and 11 domains; enforced security guardrails, human-in-loop approval gates, and ACL-aware generation (tables, business rules, ACLs, UI layouts) with self-healing via the Automated Test Framework.

Led the ALA Release Lifecycle Documentation Agent and App Summary Agent (Now Assist for Creator): automated delta analysis and CAB-ready deployment manifests on the REAct agentic framework — documentation time from hours to a single click; ships as the Release lifecycle documentation agent in Now Assist for Creator.

Lead a 9-person engineering team as tech lead; lead execution for 2–3-engineer workstreams including task breakdown, technical guidance, and code reviews — plus mentoring, technical hiring, and high-bar architectural reviews; enabled teams to set up ADP skills, agents, rules, and MCP servers in a single cross-team onboarding session.

Drove production quality, observability, and operational excellence: established enterprise testing strategy with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright; performance optimization and WCAG/ARIA accessibility; debugged production issues, participated in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term fixes.

Partnered with Product, Design, and Engineering to scope, build, test, and launch platform improvements; make sound trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability in a fast-moving environment and communicate reasoning clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Contributed to frontend infrastructure and global engineering initiatives; identified codebase problem areas, drove improvement proposals, interviewed candidates, and mentored junior engineers.
Led the Actions Team frontend, migrating the application from Angular to React and cutting page load time in half.
Delivered the Actions feature and management dashboard; raised accessibility compliance from 80% to 95% for a broad user base.
Built maintainable, scalable, and testable features; mentored junior developers and reviewed code.
Built products and services using JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Meteor, and REST APIs.

Completed the Benefit Plan Copy project, reducing test-to-production HRMS data setup time by 80% while preserving production integrity.
